summary: 一种苯乙胺家族的迷幻剂，存在于迷幻仙人掌中，长期被美国西南部和墨西哥原住民使用，包括佩奥特和圣佩德罗等。可作为仙人掌浆、提取物或实验室合成物获得。
effectsSummary: Mescaline mainly has a psychedelic effect. It enhances perception, promotes visual hallucinations such as geometric patterns and color intensification, changes time perception and can produce spiritual experiences.
dosageRemark: Mescaline is significantly less potent than LSD or psilocybin. Typical doses are in the 200-400mg range.
generalRisks: Nausea and vomiting are common, especially during the come-up phase. Increased blood pressure and heart rate. Psychological distress possible at high doses.
longtermRisks: No research results on long-term risks. HPPD is rare but possible. The main risk is psychological distress during the experience.
saferUse: 只在良好的身心状态下使用。
选择安全舒适的环境。建议有经验丰富的陪护人。
避免与其他药物混合使用。
提前了解可能的身体副作用（特别是恶心）。

[TBT] Plan enough time for recovery after the trip (at least 1 day)!
[TBT] Mescaline trips should remain exceptional experiences and should in no case be experienced more than once a month.
